basic_info.description: A Remarkable 3-Bedroom, 2-Bath Home with Versatile Living Spaces Welcome to 315 Topeka—a stylish home with great curb appeal and a flexible layout. Fresh exterior paint, an inviting balcony, and a welcoming foyer set the tone. Inside, parquet hardwood floors and large windows fill the home with natural light. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace and flows into a gourmet eat-in kitchen with high-end appliances, including a bold red Wolf stove, generous counter space, and modern cabinetry. A beautifully updated stone bathroom on the main level offers style and function.  Fresh interior paint brightens the main floor, especially the nicely sized bedrooms. Downstairs, the third bedroom offers flexibility with its own full kitchen and bathroom—ideal as a private suite, guest space, or retreat.  The mature backyard offers multiple access points from inside, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. With charm, space, and versatility, this home is ready for its next chapter.
